activity_summary: You walked the close twice and came back to the door. You asked what kept the Mayor from sleeping. You tried one line aloud, heard how grand it sounded through the stopped nose, and laughed at it before you went in.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the memo from the door, laughed, and stopped.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Named as the Mayor whose window was lit. Not seen and not addressed.

facets.activity: Laughed at a line and came in

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The nose made it grand. I laughed.
